integrity: Analytic theorem reconstructed with explicit continuant inequalities; finite exact rational checker is supporting evidence, not an infinite proof. Originality comparison remains subject to specialized unindexed literature.
scientific_limitations: The universal agreement theorem assumes unit edge weights and uniform positive screening, noiseless landmarks and 2<=k<=n. Below screening 1/2 it establishes existence of divergent designs rather than a complete trace-optimal classification. The full 2001 product-covariance thesis and 2010 Kriging paper remain inaccessible comparison risks.
title: A sharp universal screening threshold for trace- and determinant-optimal Nyström landmarks on paths
